d: Watch-along with Brandon as he revisits one of his favorite episodes that features a couple whose Lhasa Apso was trained to serve as the ring bearer in their wedding. Then, a surprise reunion that you won't want to miss.

Watch-along with Brandon as he revisits one of his favorite episodes featuring an anxious, five-year old chocolate lab mix that becomes the perfect companion for a couple of empty nesters. Then, a surprise reunion that you won't want to miss.

After surviving what could have only been canine distemper, a four-year Spaniel mix gets a second chance at Lucky Dog Ranch. But will the physical and neurological effects of the disease affect Zeus' ability to learn the common commands and find a forever home?
Before five rescue dogs can move into their new forever homes, Brandon must make sure that the new arrangements will be safe for everyone involved.
A Pomeranian mix could be the perfect dog for a retired couple and their autistic son.
A shy Spaniel mix could be the newest addition to a family that has two energetic young boys. But in order for Otis to fit in with his siblings, he must learn the importance of going to bed on cue.

In order to prepare a young Husky for life with his new family, Brandon must make sure that this former escape artist can part ways with his bad habits to prevent additional repeat visits to the local shelter.

An abandoned poodle mix could be the perfect match for a lonely woman who is starting life over again. But before Brandon can connect this downcast duo, he must bring the cautious canine out of his shell.
To prepare a Newfoundland mix for a schoolteacher hoping to bring her new dog to school with her, Brandon will have to make sure the dog has the control to be around children and distractions.

A married couple seeks a canine companion that can put a smile on the face of their daughter with special needs. But, before a young Maltese-Terrier mix can move in with the family, Eric will need to make sure that she poses no safety risk.

Becoming a photographic model requires special training for a spaniel mix named Bean. The same is true for preparing Buddy, Lolly, Sheela and Dakota for their new lives in the world of arts & entertainment.
Eric takes on the challenge of training three young shelter dogs that are full of energy.

A woman seeks Brandon's help finding a canine companion for her family. But before a spaniel mix found living on the streets can be adopted, he must prove that he can get along with other animals cared for by the potential adopter.

A young Labrador-Pointer mix is trained for teen sisters who want a mascot for their family's band. With Eric's help, this playful pup learns a special way to participate in upcoming shows by saying goodbye to his future fans.

Before a young Doberman Pinscher can become the best friend of a little boy with Autism, Brandon must make sure that the dog has the right temperament and training to help bring the boy out of his shell and assist him through life.
A Weimaraner mix must learn to play by the rules before being placed with an active, sports-loving family.
